items.title: Trump Flaunts Camaraderie With Xi and Putin but Has Little to Show for It
items.summary: President Trump called Russia’s leader his “friend” and marveled at China’s warm welcome for his first-ever trilateral summit. But there were no breakthroughs on nuclear control, the war in Ukraine or A.I.

items.title: A Summit Gives Putin the Win He Craves: Equal Stature With Superpowers
items.summary: Standing alongside the U.S. and Chinese leaders, President Vladimir V. Putin secured a symbolic triumph in his long quest to restore Russia’s place as a global power.

items.title: At Summit With Xi and Putin, Trump Seeks to Project Power Abroad While Sharing It at Home
items.summary: Weakened by the midterm elections, President Trump offered hugs, arm pats and smiles to autocrats from Russia and China in contrast to the threats he is making to ascendant Democrats in Washington.

items.title: Top White House Cybersecurity Official Is Replaced
items.summary: The departure of Sean Cairncross comes after a series of technological outages affected U.S. companies and federal agencies in the past week.

items.title: Technology Promised Ease. Outages Are Making Many Americans Uneasy.
items.summary: The recent spate of tech disruptions has forced Americans to reckon with how dependent they have become on worldwide computer networks.

items.title: What You Should Know About Downdetector Before the Next Big Tech Outage
items.summary: The website has been checked and cited often during an unusually busy week of technology problems, though its operators acknowledge its limitations.

items.title: Anthropic Debuts on Wall Street as a $2 Trillion Company
items.summary: The San Francisco company was the first major A.I. lab to go public in a highly anticipated moment for the tech industry, before ending the day valued at $1.7 trillion.

items.title: Anthropic’s I.P.O. Turns Tech Researchers Into Overnight Millionaires
items.summary: Many people who joined the A.I. company a few years ago might have had little reason to think how big Anthropic would become. They are now worth tens of millions of dollars, if not more.

items.title: How Much Anthropic Are You About to Own?
items.summary: See how much of the stock you may own through common index funds, like those found in retirement accounts.

items.title: Whatever You Thought Texas Was, It’s Bigger and Bluer Than That
items.summary: After Democrats broke a decades-long Republican winning streak this month, Texans are reflecting on who gets to define the place they call home.

items.title: Judges have put Trump's arch and golf course on hold, but only for a matter of days
items.summary: A federal judge has twice delayed construction of Trump's arch. Another is keeping East Potomac Park open. The proposed golf course redesign got mixed feedback from a federal arts panel on Thursday.

items.title: The 'Magic Six': How to strengthen your marriage in midlife
items.summary: How do we maintain healthy romantic relationships as we age? Allison Aubrey and Scott Detrow talk about about the science of healthy, later-in-life relationships.

items.title: 'Bigger than Barack Obama's election': Scholars reflect on Mississippi Senate race
items.summary: Scott Colom is now this Southern state's first Black U.S. senator in nearly 150 years. Scholars and Mississippi natives Eddie Glaude and Kiese Laymon discuss the historic significance of his victory.

items.title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
items.summary: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.

items.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
items.summary: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

items.title: World Toilet Day is a funny idea with a serious goal: A world awash in toilets
items.summary: Yahoo for the loo! November 19 marks the 25th anniversary of World Toilet Day. The theme this year: "Sanitation and Gender Equality: Safe Toilets, Equal Futures."

items.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
items.summary: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

items.title: Incoming House majority leader Katherine Clark stresses Democratic unity
items.summary: As Democrats prepare to take control of the House, incoming majority leader Katherine Clark discusses the party's ambitious agenda and divisions within its ranks.

items.title: Top House Democrat questions what Trump accomplished in Xi-Putin summit
items.summary: Rep. Gregory Meeks raises concerns about U.S. alliances after Trump's summit with Xi and Putin. He also discusses Chinese espionage amid the Nvidia scandal.

items.title: Investors scramble for a piece of AI giant Anthropic in blockbuster IPO
items.summary: Shares in the maker of the popular Claude artificial intelligence model leapt in first day of trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.

items.title: Cincinnati Zoo’s beloved hippo, Fiona, dead at 9 years old
items.summary: The hippo, who was born six weeks premature, became an internet sensation as the zoo documented her growth online.

items.title: Court to hear appeal that could lead to dismissal of Lindsay Clancy case
items.summary: Clancy’s lawyers argue that trying the Massachusetts mother on first-degree murder charges again would constitute double jeopardy.

items.title: Nvidia scandal could be tipping point toward tougher export control enforcement
items.summary: The United States has for decades struggled to reconcile corporate America’s desire to profit from a vast Chinese market with U.S. national security imperatives.

items.title: Cyberattack may have exposed Chase Bank and Mastercard customer data
items.summary: The attack on third-party vendors is unrelated to a service disruption Tuesday, Chase said.

items.title: Susan Smith denied parole 32 years after drowning sons in S.C. lake
items.summary: The boys’ father, David Smith, said it would be “an injustice” to set her free in his plea for her to remain behind bars.

items.title: Proposed change to SNAP threatens free school meals for 1.7 million children
items.summary: A Trump administration proposal affecting automatic enrollment could cut benefits for millions of families.

items.title: Most people who go to jail or prison were victims of violence first, study finds
items.summary: A new report based on data widely utilized by public health researchers examined the "victimization-to-incarceration pipeline."

items.title: A paramedic responded to a deadly accident. She discovered the victim was her son.
items.summary: A paramedic attended an accident in Sigurd, Utah, after a car fell on a man repairing it. “It was not until she heard his name” that the paramedic realized it was her son, authorities said.

items.title: The NIH is releasing the last chimpanzees used for lab testing
items.summary: The 33 primates will enjoy a life of leisure at a Louisiana sanctuary.

items.title: Unlocked cells. Family dinners. A once-violent prison is trying something new.
items.summary: The facility in Minnesota is scheduled to close after the death of a guard, a hostage situation and a riot in recent years. But a bold new experiment has inmates and guards fighting to keep it open.
